title: Great family experience!
text: This is the activity my children preferred! (9 and 12 years old) (and parents too, we loved visiting this way!) Seville is the perfect city for electric scooter riding. The Ferris wheels were perfect for control. Excellent Service. I wrote before arriving and I was answered quickly. On the spot, the clerk was trying out a few words in French. Really 10/10! We definitely recommend.

title: Superb experience of comfortable electric scooters!
text:
We were very well received, a very decent rate with 1/4 hour kindly offered, so a bottle of cool water well appreciated in this heatwave! 
The recommended tour was perfect, really nice and beautiful (the banks of the Guadalquivir, the Spanish Steps and its gardens etc ... beautiful ) 
We recommend and we will do it again!
author: GoPlaces50164275261

title: Amazing
text: What a totally brilliant 2 hours!! There were 7 of us. Iziqeul was a great guide and a great guy! We saw and were informed about historic Seville and had time in between to learn of the best bars and best food. I’d highly recommend it as an amazing experience and the only way to see,‘the real‘,Seville. Lovely family run business too. Thanks Iziquel!
author: Kzee73

title: Super fun, serious power!
text: This is absolutely my favourite activity when visiting Seville (which I do regularly) and the very best way to get to all those parts of the city and riverbank too far or too hot to walk to. A 3 hour hire of these ‘big wheel’ scooters is enough to roam widely, plenty of power and battery life even for a 20 stone (127 Kg) man to ramble up hill and down town. These scooters are legal to ride in cycle lanes (these are everywhere in Seville and Triana) and on the pavement where roads do not have a cycle Lane. title: Surfing Seville!
text: It came up in an unexpected way and was a hit. Christian the best guide, no doubt. We toured the emblematic points of Seville in two hours. We recommended bars and restaurants to go to lunch afterwards. Highly recommended!
